outcome: Launch controlled retail personalization and recovery experiments using one storefront, with conversion measurement and repeatable customer-owned journeys.
overview: Help retailers convert eligible visits into completed purchases through relevant recommendations and recovery journeys. The proposed scope covers one storefront, two personalization experiments and one abandonment journey. Deliverables include tracking validation, approved audience rules, merchandising controls and a business report separating attributed sales from measured incremental impact.
kpi: Incremental conversion and contribution margin per eligible visitor versus control.
scope: Planning estimate: six to eight weeks for one storefront, two experiments and one recovery journey. Sequence: tracking audit, catalogue validation, experience design, sandbox QA, controlled release and evaluation. Extend measurement if traffic is insufficient. Provide customer-owned campaign documentation and rollback instructions. New storefronts or a broader customer-data migration require separate scope.
